messages:
Mina: Tokyo (ap-northeast-1) GPU pool hitting sustained 92% utilization, queue growth, p95 token latency up ~2.1s. Seeing OOMs on some smaller machines. Need soft reroute + immediate mitigation.
Santiago: On it. Any signal which customer cohorts are spiking? cc @Leah
Mina: Mostly free-tier and a couple of high-burst eval jobs from X-product. No enterprise pinned models in these pools. Suggest spill: 20% -> ap-southeast-1, 10% -> na-east-1, gradual 5% steps to avoid cache churn.
gslb-bot: Alert: ap-northeast-1 nodegroup-4 degraded. Autoscaler failed to add nodes due to quota. Link: https://console.internal/ops/queue/2134 :warning:
Leah: Quota is the blocker? Can we request burst quota from cloud? Might take 20-30m. Prefer routing changes now to reduce impact.
Cory: Agree. Plan: apply routing override on GLC. Dry-run command:
```
curl -X POST https://glc.internal/api/v1/overrides -d '{\"region\":\"ap-northeast-1\",\"weights\":{\"ap-southeast-1\":0.2,\"na-east-1\":0.1},\"step\":0.05,\"interval\":120}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $GLC_TOKEN'
```
Mina: Looks good. Also enable prefix KV caching for repeat customers to cut token regen. Ops-SRE can you flip route cache TTL 5s -> 30s for the ap-northeast route?
Ops-SRE: Pushing TTL change in ~2m. Also enabling aggressive prefix caching for traffic tagged `test-runner` and `smoke`.
Santiago: Initiating step-1: +5% to ap-southeast-1 now.
gslb-bot: Override applied: ap-northeast-1 weight -0.05 -> ap-southeast-1 +0.05. Monitor: p95 latency -200ms in 3m, queue length -12%.
Leah: :thumbsup: Keep an eye on egress/cost -- redirect to na-east will up egress by ~18% for some customers.
Mina: Will monitor metrics and cost. If quota approved we'll scale pool and revert. Thanks team.
